div.p: 1 — Authentication cascade (free). Every chain through the phone now fails at the revocation hop, so the tablet dies too without being named. Converges on every verifier, even one offline at the time (the log is an order-independent set; revocation wins). Revoked keys can never be re-paired.

2 — Message-key cascade (must be enacted). The phone & tablet still hold the current room key. A remaining key-holder emits room_key_rotate to a new epoch, wrapped to the device keys of the surviving subtree only (DeviceLog.Subtree is excluded). Pre-revocation history stays readable — keys can't be un-shared.
